subject: SS
title: Reading the social pyramid
teach: A social class is a group with a similar position in society. A social pyramid shows rank: a small group at the top had more power; larger groups lower down had less power.
Read your teacher’s five diagram labels from top to bottom: Pharaoh; Priests and nobles; Traders, artisans, shopkeepers, and scribes; Farmers and herders; Unskilled workers.

The diagram’s bottom label is Unskilled workers. The readings also discuss enslaved people and servants below farmers. Do not replace the diagram’s exact label when the question asks for that diagram. Lower rank does not mean work was unimportant.

example.prompt: In the teacher’s diagram, were scribes above or below farmers?
example.thinking: Find each labeled level. Scribes share a level with traders, artisans and shopkeepers. Farmers and herders are one level below.
example.answer: Scribes were above farmers in the teacher’s diagram.
example.why: The answer uses the labeled levels. It does not claim that farming was unimportant.
